text: At the Swansea Town Hall Board Meeting on May 27, 2021, the Board nominated the individuals listed above for appointment by Toronto and East York Community Council to the Board of Management of the Swansea Town Hall Community Centre. Appointments to the Swansea Town Hall Community Centre Board of Management is a matter for which the Community Council has been delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision, provided that the recommendations do not vary from the Public Appointments Policy. The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Appointed, at pleasure of Council, the following candidates, for the term of eight (8) months ending on May 31, 2022: Glen Dunphy Ayan Kailie Justine Montgomery Phil Vlach Brian O’Rourke
